title: Echo is an AI inference system that shows you don't always need a bigger model to get better results
description:
Echo is an AI inference system that shows you don't always need a bigger model to get better results.

Instead of relying on a single LLM, it intelligently routes tasks across multiple open-weight models, allocating just the right amount of compute before combining the strongest outputs into one final answer.

The result is frontier-level coding performance at a significantly lower cost, making it an exciting approach for developers building AI-powered applications.

If you're interested in the future of AI inference, this is one project worth watching.
